commands:
RUNID="${GITHUB_RUN_ID:-local}-${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT:-1}"; echo "run-id=$RUNID"
mkdir -p .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1535/$RUNID
gh pr diff 1535 | awk '/^diff --git/{in_logs=/ [ab]\/\.prflow\/logs\//} !in_logs' | tee .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1535/$RUNID/diff.patch > /dev/null
echo "diff-bytes=$(wc -l < .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1535/$RUNID/diff.patch)"
echo "---FILES---"
grep '^diff --git' .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1535/$RUNID/diff.patch | sed -E 's|^diff --git a/(.*) b/.*|\1|'

RUNID="${GITHUB_RUN_ID:-local}-${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT:-1}"; echo "run-id=$RUNID"
mkdir -p .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1535/$RUNID
gh pr diff 1535 | awk '/^diff --git/{in_logs=/ [ab]\/\.prflow\/logs\//} !in_logs' | tee .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1535/$RUNID/diff.patch | tail -1
echo "===DONE==="

RUNID=$(printf '%s-%s' "${GITHUB_RUN_ID:-local}" "${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT:-1}"); echo "run-id=$RUNID"; mkdir -p .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1535/"$RUNID"; gh pr diff 1535 | awk '/^diff --git/{in_logs=/ [ab]\/\.prflow\/logs\//} !in_logs' | tee .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1535/"$RUNID"/diff.patch | tail -1; echo "===DONE==="

scrub.shapes: GitHub tokens/PATs, Anthropic keys, Bearer Authorization headers, and basic Authorization headers
